title: haplophyllum albanicum
intro: Haplophyllum albanicum, commonly known as Albanian spurge, is a plant species that belongs to the Rutaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Haplophyllum albanicum are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and exhibit antiviral and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
